description_en: The apartment is located near the Mosaic of Tirana, it is positioned on the fifth floor of a new building with an elevator. It is organized in; - a living room together with a cooking corner. - two bedrooms. - two toilets - a storage room - and two balconies. - gross area 110 m/2 - net area 90 - The very favorable south-east orientation enables natural lighting during the day - The apartment is invested in details and is sold furnished. - Has documentation of the mortgage rule.
